Layer.CurrentSongChangedMessageCommand:
%function(self) local ArtEle = BMIIDX14Glob.CourseArtist if ArtEle and (not FirstTweenOver) then ArtEle:finishtweening() ArtEle:diffusealpha(0) ArtEle:addy(-12)
ArtEle:decelerate(0.2) ArtEle:diffusealpha(1) ArtEle:addy(12) end end
%function(self) if not FirstTweenOver then self:finishtweening() end self:queuecommand('UpdateTitle') end
Layer.UpdateTitleCommand:
%function(self) local course = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentCourse() if course then if not FirstTweenOver then self:diffusealpha(0) self:addx(-24) end
self:settext(course:GetDisplayFullTitle())
if not FirstTweenOver then self:decelerate(0.2) self:diffusealpha(1) self:addx(24) end else self:settext('') end end
